method: Quarterly OECD DF_QNA population (T0110, thousands) used unchanged wherever published. Before each country's first quarterly period, quarters from 1975-Q1 are derived from OECD annual population (DF_TABLE3 T0110, thousands; econ_population_annual.json): each annual value is pinned at mid-year (t=year+0.5, the Q2/Q3 boundary); quarter q of year y sits at its midpoint t=y+(q-0.5)/4; values linearly interpolated between annual pins. Bridge: derived quarters after the last annual pin before the join are linearly interpolated between that annual value and the first published quarterly value, so there is no jump. Annual-derived quarters carry status 'Y' = derived from OECD annual population. Units: thousands of persons in both sources (UNIT_MULT 3).

status_codes.Y: Derived from OECD annual population (see method)

measure: Population, OECD, thousands of persons, quarterly (joined)
source: OECD DF_QNA POP T0110 (quarterly) + OECD DF_TABLE3 POP T0110 (annual, pre-quarterly years only)
